## ACA Essential by Trusaic for UKG Ready

## (IRS and State)

**Currently, UKG Ready’s ACA Manager helps you create the 1094-C and 1095-C tax 
data that must be filed with the IRS & states.**

• However, IRS and State Filings are not supported

• And users don’t receive insight into IRS penalty risk associated with their 1095-C codes

• But that’s all changing shortly!

**Starting December 2024, UKG Ready and Trusaic have partnered to launch a 
powerful and exciting new integration that lets you quickly and easily:**

• Perform ACA filings in all jurisdictions: IRS & State Filings

---

## ACA Essential by Trusaic for UKG Ready

## (IRS and State)

## • Powerful Bi-Directional API Integration

▪ UKG Ready is integrating with Trusaic to provide seamless ACA Filings of 1094-C and 1095-C 
tax form data.

## • All ACA jurisdictions supported (IRS & States)

▪ IRS Filings + State Filings (CA, RI, NJ, DC)

▪ Any future jurisdictional requirements added will also be supported

## • Perform ACA filings without leaving the UKG platform

▪ For UKG Ready customers with the ACA Manager enabled

**• Service Support:** Helpful ACA experts available to answer any questions.

**• Pricing:** The ACA Filings service is available at an additional cost

## App Categories: HR Add-ons

ACA Filing powered by Trusaic
By Trusaic 06/13/2024

Navigating ACA compliance can be complex and time-consuming. Trusaic simplifies this process with automated data handling and streamlined reporting. Upon receipt (via data integration between the UKG Ready platform and Trusaic's ACA platform) of the data underlying the customer's IRS Forms 1094-C and 1095-C for an applicable ACA reporting year, Trusaic will perform ACA filings with the IRS and/or California, Rhode Island, New Jersey or Washington D.C. in accordance with the request specified by the customer user, within the UKG Ready platform, at the point where the customer initiates the data transmission from UKG Ready to Trusaic's ACA platform.

## Overview Pricing

Navigating ACA compliance can be complex and time-consuming. Trusaic simplifies this process with automated data handling and streamlined reporting. Upon receipt (via data integration between the UKG Ready platform and Trusaic's ACA platform) of the data underlying the customer's IRS Forms 1094-C and 1095-C for an applicable ACA reporting year, Trusaic will perform ACA filings with the IRS and/or California, Rhode Island, New Jersey or Washington D.C. in accordance with the request specified by the customer user, within the UKG Ready platform, at the point where the customer initiates the data transmission from UKG Ready to Trusaic's ACA platform.

Trusaic will provide confirmation of filing statuses, including relevant filing status details provided by the IRS and/or the states requiring ACA filings.

Trusaic will also provide any relevant errors reports provided by the filing agencies to the customer.

Trusaic will support filings corrections/adjustments.

INSTRUCTIONS TO INSTALL:

Step 1: Sign up: Add the "ACA Filing powered by Trusaic" to the company.

Step 2: Go to "Installed" tab. Review and accept service description, pricing and terms and conditions to enroll.

Step 3: Complete company & contact settings by filling in the required information.

Step 4: Click on SAVE.

Step 5: Check your inbox for email from Trusaic for your account details shared in step 3.

Step 6: Do you need more information? Trusaic is happy to help! Please contact UKGReadyACA@trusaic.com. Support hours are Monday - Friday, 6am - 6pm PT.
